UCR CCN Info Night
Wednesday, September 30th | 8 PM
Pentland Bear Cave
_____________________________________________

WHATS UP CSA 📣 Who wants to learn about our biggest production of the year 👀 Come out to learn about our Chinese Culture Night 🎭

We will be giving out energy drinks tonight in our meeting 👀 FIRST COME FIRST SERVE FOR ENERGY DRINKS ‼️

Don’t miss out on our after social at Tra Boba! (shuttling @ lot 15 🚗)

If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to message @joshua.shiu our CCN director, for more information!
